steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: This town has recently become home to an illness known as the Sleeper Plague. It's a nasty affliction. Those infected fall into a deep sleep, never to wake.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Now, Morytania is no stranger to odd afflictions. However, I've been doing some digging. Apparently, this isn't the first time this illness has beset Slepe. In fact, they say it's how the town was named.

steps.player: And now the illness is back. You said you suspect the vampyres are involved?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I do. The first victim of the new Sleeper Plague was none other than Lady Crombwick. She rules over this town from Crombwick Manor, along with her husband.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: He's not been seen since she fell ill, and their manor has been locked down.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Here's the interesting part though. Vampyres have been seen around the manor. Apparently they showed up around the time when the Sleeper Plague returned.

steps.player: I see where this is going. You think the vampyres are the reason the plague is back.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I do. The question is, why?

steps.player: I guess that's for us to work out. Where do we start?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We'll split up. I'm going to try and learn more about these vampyres at the manor. While I do that, I want you to try and find the source of the illness.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: They're looking after the victims in this church here. I'd recommend you make that your starting point.

steps.player: Sounds like a plan. Good luck.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: And to you. Myreque prevail.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?

steps.player: How have things been for you recently?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We haven't been doing too bad. Even out in Mort Myre, the impact of Ranis' death can be seen.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: People have a little bit more hope now, and it has become easier for us to gather support.

steps.player: That's good to know.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Of course, there are downsides. The vampyres are hunting us with ever greater determination. But this is the life we chose.

options.text: What do you know about this place?

steps.player: What do you know about this place?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Slepe? It's wretched. The people of this town follow the teachings of Zamorak. Some are no better than the vampyres themselves.

steps.player: Do they get on with the vampyres?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: As well as any humans can. All settlements in Morytania must pay the vampyres in blood tithes, but the people of Slepe do so willingly.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: They see the vampyres as fellow servants of Zamorak. Of course, the vampyres only really serve themselves.

steps.player: So why do these people follow Zamorak?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Apparently this place was founded by a group called the Sisterhood, former healers of Saradomin that turned to Zamorak.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Their order still exists to this day. You'll probably see a few of them around the town.

options.text: Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

steps.player: Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: What I told you is pretty much what I know. The illness causes people to fall to sleep, never to wake again.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: There's a rumour that the infected are also granted immortality, though I don't know if there's any truth in this.

steps.player: To be honest, immortality doesn't seem very useful if you're unable to wake up.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Indeed. If history is to be believed, this is the second time the Sleeper Plague has hit Slepe. The first occurrence was many years ago and is supposedly what gave the town its name.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: That's all I know. That said, I suspect you might be able to learn more if you do some digging around town.

options.text: I'd better get going.

steps.player: I'd better get going.

options.text: No.

steps.player: Actually, I'm a bit busy right now. Maybe later.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Very well friend. Myreque prevail.

slepe-s-sleeper-plague-talking-to-veliaf.text: You need to try and find the source of the Sleeper Plague. I'd start in the church. That's where they're looking after the victims.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Carl? What do you want?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Kroy. We've run out of Bloody Bracer again.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Did you really need to come here to tell me that?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: There's something else as well. Someone's been poking around, asking about Bloody Bracer.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Who?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I don't know. They don't look to be from around here.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: So someone's been snooping around asking questions, and you decided to come here? What if they followed you?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I... I thought you'd want to know.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: You're a fool Carl. If you're not careful, you'll jeopardise everything.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Hey! I don't need to help you!

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: No, you don't. Your predecessor didn't want to help us. Perhaps you remember what came of him?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Go back to your pub Carl. I'll have more Bloody Bracer sent over soon. In the meantime, try to be a bit smarter.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Carl
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Fine.
Carl leaves the lab, failing to notice the player eavesdropping. Afterwards, Damien Leucurte enters the lab, followed by Vanstrom Klause.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Alright then, Damien. What is it that you're so keen to show me?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Vanstrom, I'd like you to meet Kroy.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Greetings, my lord.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Don't tell me you had me come all the way down here for this? Look at the wretched thing, Damien. It's barely even a proper juvenile.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Well just hang on there, Vanstrom. Kroy may not look like much, but I've never met a vampyre with a better knowledge of herblore.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Kroy, tell him what you found.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Of course, my lord.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: It was hidden deep within the sanctuary here. A recipe, for an elixir.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: An elixir?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Yes! The ones that built the place, the Sisterhood, they called it the Elixir of Everlasting.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: And just what is this Elixir of Everlasting?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Those who drink it find their lives heavily extended, but at a cost. They are put into a deep sleep, never to wake.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: So the Sleeper Plague? That was your doing?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Indeed. Using the recipe, Kroy was easily able to recreate the elixir. After a quick test on Lady Crombwick, we started giving it to the citizens.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: We hide it in their beer, Bloody Bracer. They've no idea what it's really doing to them!

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: And while they sleep, we tithe them. The sleepers only need a fraction of the blood a normal human needs, so we can take more than ever before!

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: And tell me, Damien, who gave you permission to do this?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The nobles of Darkmeyer make their demands Vanstrom. Someone has to meet them.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: That someone is not you. I am in charge of blood tithing. I alone decide how it is to be carried out.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The nobles are restless. They are tired of inaction. I saw an opportunity and I took it. Lord Drakan should thank me.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I don't doubt the ingenuity of your plan. This elixir could have great potential. The thing I doubt is your recklessness. This Sleeper Plague has attracted attention. The wrong kind of attention.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The Myreque? Don't tell me you're scared of that lot, Vanstrom? I thought you were made of stronger stuff.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I do not fear the Myreque. I have no need to. They have no way of touching me.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: But you on the other hand, you should be very afraid. Out here alone, without the support of the Drakan household. You're a prime target. And if what I hear is true, they're right on your doorstep.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: What's that supposed to mean?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: The Myreque are already here in Slepe, Damien. The one that killed Ranis Drakan is among them. Your overconfidence has begun your downfall.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Damien Leucurte
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Well you'll have to do something. You'll need to send us some support.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I will do no such thing. You defied Lord Drakan when you came out here. The consequences of your actions are your own to deal with.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I will be on my way. There are things in Darkmeyer that require my attention.
Vanstrom leaves via the ladder, followed by Damien. The player enters Kroy's lab immediately after.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: How much did you hear, human?

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: I see. Then you know that I can't let you leave this place alive.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.player: Tempting offer. Death isn't on my to-do list today though, so I'll have to decline.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: A joker? Your arrogance will be your end, human.

plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.speaker: Kroy
plague-s-end-eavesdropping-on-carl.text: Yes... We shall...
Kroy attacks the player.

plague-s-end-after-killing-kroy.player: Well that's him dealt with. I should destroy his lab as well. Don't want anyone else continuing his work.

plague-s-end-after-destroying-the-lab-ta.player: There. That should stop anyone from continuing Kroy's work. I should inform Veliaf.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Well met friend. Anything to report?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: You were right about the vampyres. I did some digging and discovered that they are indeed the cause of the Sleeper Plague.
A vampyre in the dungeon called Kroy was making infected Bloody Bracers. The local barkeep was then selling them to the townspeople.
I put a stop to that though. I killed Kroy and destroyed his lab. The barkeep has no supply now.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Excellent work friend. This should stop any new cases of the illness.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: There's something else, too. While I was spying on Kroy, I saw Vanstrom Klause with another vampyre called Damien. It sounded like Damien was Kroy's boss.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: The vampyre you speak of is a noble called Damien Leucurte. He's a known quantity to us. My investigations at the manor also involved the two of them, but let's hear the rest of your findings first.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: Well, in their conversations, it was revealed why they caused the new Sleeper Plague. Apparently, they did it to make it easier to take blood tithes.
But here's the interesting thing. Vanstrom didn't seem very happy with this. It sounded like Damien was doing it without his permission.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: This is all very interesting. The citizens of this town are Zamorakians and willingly give their blood to the vampyres. Why would Damien need the Sleeper Plague?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: He talked about increased demand from the nobles of Darkmeyer. Perhaps they have need for more blood than normal?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: That would make sense. I've heard rumours that the vampyre population has grown such that demand for blood now exceeds supply. Damien may be looking for ways to satisfy this demand.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Even so, this seems extreme. And to go behind Vanstrom's back as well? Maybe their overcrowding issues are bigger than we first realised.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: Maybe. So, what's our next move?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: I have an idea about that, although my information is not quite as exciting as yours I'm afraid.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: While I was investigating the manor, I discovered that it has indeed been taken over by vampyres. Our friend Damien seems to be the leader of this group.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: During my time there, I also managed to spy on Vanstrom and Damien. I only heard a small part of their conversation, but Vanstrom didn't seem very happy, which matches up with what you heard.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: At one point, Vanstrom insulted Damien for his recklessness and accused him of demanding too much from the werewolves. Sounds like they've also been gathering extra blood without permission.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: That sounds familiar. I suspect it was werewolves who attacked me that time at Paterdomus.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Yes, that encounter also sprung into my mind. It sounds like things are even worse now.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: So you want to investigate the werewolves?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: I do indeed. Something is going on in Darkmeyer that's causing this increased demand. If there's unrest in the city, we might be able to use it to our advantage.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.player: What about Slepe? Should we not deal with Damien as well?

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Not yet. Your actions will have drawn attention to us. We cannot stay here. It sounds like Damien can do little without Kroy, so I doubt he'll be much trouble anyway.

an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-reporting-back-to-.text: Besides, we've already done too much for these Zamorakians. There are others more deserving of our time.

options.text: But aren't we meant to help people?

steps.player: But aren't we meant to help people?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: That's a complicated question friend. But yes, of course we are meant to help people.

steps.player: Then why are we letting Damien get away with this? Carl as well?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Damien and Carl are small fish in a very big pond. Dealing with them might help the people here, but it will mean nothing to the rest of Morytania.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: If we want to help as many people as possible, we need to think bigger than that. The Drakan family, they are the real targets.

steps.player: I suppose. It just seems harsh to leave these people in the hands of a vampyre like Damien.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: We've already done a lot to help here. Besides, Damien will get what's coming to him in the end, I'm sure of that.

steps.player: You're sure this isn't just because they're Zamorakian?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Zamorakians are evil my friend, it does not shame me to say it. But no, if this were a Saradominist town, my actions would be the same.

steps.player: Okay, fair enough.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: You have a good heart my friend. I have a lot of respect for that. I assure you that if we keep on our current path, we will bring freedom to all of Morytania.

steps.player: Thank you, Veliaf. So, what's our next move?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Meet me at Paterdomus friend. We will check in with Drezel and Ivan, before continuing our investigation.

steps.player: Okay, I'll meet you there.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Be careful out there. Myreque prevail.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?
What do you know about this place?
Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?
I'd better get going.
Fair enough, so what now?

steps.player: Fair enough, so what now?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Meet me at Paterdomus friend. We will check in with Drezel and Ivan, before continuing our investigation.

steps.player: Okay, I'll meet you there.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Be careful out there. Myreque prevail.

options.text: How have things been for you recently?
What do you know about this place?
Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?
I'd better get going.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Well met friend. Good to see you made it in one piece.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Indeed, I hear Morytania becomes more dangerous by the day.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: You can say that again. Good to see you Drezel. Has Veliaf already filled you in?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Not yet, I thought it best to wait for you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: But you're here now, so let's get started.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Well Drezel, the reason we are here is due to an investigation we've been conducting in Slepe.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ah. I hear it's a nasty place, full of Zamorakian filth. Suffering from some sort of outbreak as well, I've been told.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Yes, the Sleeper Plague. It turns out, however, that the vampyres are responsible.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Seems that one of their nobles, Damien Leucurte, has been looking for ways to increase blood output. Interestingly, he's been doing it without consent from the Drakan family.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: That's right. Vanstrom doesn't seem to be very happy about it.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Interesting. It's odd you should come to report this, because we've also experienced some strange happenings around here.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Hmm. Do these strange happenings have anything to do with werewolves, by any chance?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: They do.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: I knew it. What's been going on?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Well, after [player name] here was ambushed outside the temple a while back, Ivan and I decided to keep a closer eye on things.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: For a time, nothing unusual happened. The reports of trouble in the area died down, and everything seemed normal.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Perhaps their encounter with you scared them off, [player name].

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Maybe. But if so, it was only for a time. A few weeks ago, the reports of people going missing in the area started again. And they're much worse this time.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Entire groups have been going missing. Not just miners and travellers either. Even some of the king's mercenaries have vanished.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Did you send word to the king?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: We did. His adviser though, Aeonisig, encouraged him to refrain from military action.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Typical. This is why I hate politics.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Has anyone seen who's been doing this? Is it definitely werewolves?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: We believe so. Ivan has been keeping a close watch. The disappearances have mostly taken place further up the pass, however, so it's taken a while for him to find any leads.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: But he has found one?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Yes, last night. He overheard a hooded figure mention a meeting in the Haunted Woods, directly south of Fenkenstrain's Castle, that is apparently set for today.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Perfect. Sounds like that's where we should head next then.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: On the topic of Ivan, where is he Drezel?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ah... Well that's just the thing. He went to spy on the meeting.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: What? You just let him go? He's just a boy!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: He's a grown man, Veliaf! One far smarter than either you or I. If he wants to do something, he will do it. I can't stop him!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: You should have sent word to us! This is for us to deal with, not him!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: There wasn't time. He only found out about the meeting last night!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Ivan is still a member of the Myreque, isn't he? Surely he can look after himself.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: That's not the point! He needs to be kept safe!

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: I don't understand. Why is Ivan so important?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ivan... Well, Ivan is special. He is the last in his bloodline.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Ivan is the last living descendant of Ivandis Seergaze himself. Once I am gone, he will be the only remaining descendant of the Seven Priestly Warriors.

options.text: Seven Priestly Warriors?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Are you becoming forgetful, [player name]? The Seven Priestly Warriors were the ones who originally blessed the River Salve.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Without their sacrifice, Drakan and his kin would have long since taken over Misthalin.

steps.player: Ah yes, I remember. So, this is why you want to keep Ivan safe, Veliaf?

options.text: I see. So that's why you want to keep him safe, Veliaf?

steps.player: I see. So that's why you want to keep him safe, Veliaf?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: It's not just about that. There's also the promise I made. Before his mother died, I swore to her on my life that I would shield Ivan from any harm.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Though I nearly failed her when Vanstrom killed Sani and Harold.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Veliaf, my friend, you and I will not be around to protect Ivan forever. We have guided him to this point, but maybe it's time for him to start looking after himself.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: And what of his learnings here? You would have him abandon them?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: I have taught Ivan everything I know. There is nothing more he can gain from me.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.player: Forgive me, but this can be resolved later. For now, we need to find Ivan and see what this meeting is about.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Yes, you're absolutely right, friend. Forgive us. Directly south of Fenkenstrain's Castle. Is that right Drezel?

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: That's right. In the Haunted Woods.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Very well. Meet me there, [player name]. Let's see if we can find out what's going on.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Oh, and [player name], I would appreciate it if you could avoid mentioning the stuff about Ivandis Seergaze to Ivan. One day he will have to bear that burden. But for now, he has enough weight on his shoulders.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Good luck to you both. Saradomin be with you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: Meet me in the Haunted Woods, just south of Fenkenstrain's Castle. We will hopefully find Ivan there.

an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-checking-in-at-pat.text: You should head for the Haunted Woods, friend. With luck, you'll find Ivan just south of Fenkenstrain's Castle.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Seven Priestly Warriors?

steps.player: Could you tell me more about the Seven Priestly Warriors?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Well at this point you should be no stranger to their tale, though I understand the desire for a recap.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: During the Fourth Age, the vampyre forces of Lowerniel Drakan attempted to invade Misthalin. They would have succeeded, were it not for the Seven Priestly Warriors.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: The warriors were the ones to bless the River Salve and build this temple, ensuring that Misthalin would be forever safe from the evils of Morytania.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Sadly, all seven of them fell in the final battle against Drakan. They are now buried here, in this very mausoleum.

steps.player: I don't know if that's completely true.

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: You talk of the suggestion that Ivandis Seergaze isn't actually buried with the others, don't you? That isn't a conversation I wish to have.

steps.player: Fair enough. Anything else you can tell me about the Warriors?

steps.speaker: Drezel
steps.text: Not really. You might learn more in the library below, but I'd be cautious of believing every word in those books.

steps.player: Okay. Thanks Drezel.

options.text: I'm on it.

steps.player: I'm on it.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: [player name]! So good to see you. What brings you out here?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: Hello there, Ivan. Believe it or not, I'm actually here for you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: For me? I'm guessing Drezel sent you?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: That's right. He told us of your discovery about the werewolves. We came to lend a hand.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: We? Is Veliaf with you?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: Yes. We've been investigating something together. We suspect it may be connected to this situation with the werewolves. I imagine he'll be here shortly.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Veliaf arrives at the meeting spot.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Veliaf!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ivan. It's good to see you safe.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: And you. [player name] says you're here about the werewolves.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Indeed. But Ivan, you shouldn't be out here. It's not safe for you. Head back to the temple, let [player name] and I take it from here.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Don't worry, Veliaf. I can look after myself.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ivan...
Three werewolves arrive at the meeting spot with a family of prisoners, and greet Damien and two vampyre juvinates.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You're late.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Well look who it is. Damien Leucurte! I thought you didn't like to associate with our lot.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Scared of getting mud on his pretty clothes, I bet.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Mind your tongue, dog, or I'll have you put in a collar.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Your threats mean nothing out here Damien. There're no Drakans around to protect you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Not that Drakan protection means much these days anyway. His own brother killed by a human. How does he respond? He stays hiding in his fancy castle.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ha! You think this one would get Drakan protection even if he were about? I hear Vanstrom has found out about this little side venture. Little Damien has been a very naughty boy.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Enough of this! What do you have for me?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A nice family of three, out for a little picnic a bit too close to the Salve.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Prisoner
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Please... don't hurt us. We'll do anything!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Shut up!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Three? Is that all?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Well if you want more, you're welcome to cross the Salve yourself and get them.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: There's been a setback with our operations in Slepe. We need you to make up the shortfall. Next time, bring more.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You assume there's going to be a next time. I bet you don't last another week now that the Myreque are running around with vampyre-killing weapons.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A week? He won't even last another day at the rate he's going!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Damien Leucurte
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I tire of your arrogance. We're done here.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Yes, we are. See you around Damien.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Werewolf
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Or not.
The werewolves leave the meeting.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: So it's as we suspected. The werewolves have been taking people from across the Salve.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: But they've been doing so without permission, just like in Slepe.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: This doesn't give us anything more to go on though. We have our suspicions, but we still don't know for sure why they are doing this.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Should we follow them? Maybe we'll learn more if we do. We might also get a chance to save that poor family.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: No, it's too risky. Last thing we need is you getting captured, Ivan.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Hang on... Do you two hear something?
Vanescula Drakan appears; Veliaf attempts to attack her, but is knocked back and stunned. Afterwards, she snares the player, Veliaf, and Ivan.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Go on then! Finish it!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Oh Veliaf my dear, If I'd wanted you dead I'd have done it a long time ago.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You're not here to kill us?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: No... I'm here to talk...
Vanescula transforms into her human form.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: So... Let's talk.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I take it you know who I am?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You're Vanescula Drakan, sister to Lowerniel Drakan.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: And formally, sister to Ranis Drakan, before [player name] here came along.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ah yes, [player name], the great vampyre slayer. I would thank you, were it not for the fact that his funeral was such a dull affair.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: There was no love between Ranis and I. You did us a favour when you got rid of him.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: That's a shame. Maybe I shouldn't have bothered.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Oh on the contrary, the death of Ranis was just what we needed.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Save your words. You didn't come to thank us for Ranis. Why are you here?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Ah, and there I was thinking we were starting to become friends. Fine. I'm here to make you an offer. A once in a lifetime offer.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Which is?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You've already killed one of my brothers. Now I offer you the chance to kill the other.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Alone, you have no hope of ever getting close to Lowerniel. Now, I on the otherhand, can get you right into his chambers at Castle Drakan.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: And why would you want that?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I have my reasons.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Care to share them?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I will, but not here.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: To the south east of Meiyerditch, there's an old graveyard. The Icyene Graveyard, we call it. Gather the Myreque, every member, and meet me there. That is where I will present my proposal.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Every member of the Myreque? Do you take us for fools? You're trying to lure us all there to wipe us out.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: As I said to you earlier, Veliaf, if I wanted you dead I'd have done it long ago.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You're bluffing!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Am I? So if I were to head to the Burgh de Rott inn and go down into the basement, what would I find?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You...

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: If I were to give the order, I could have the heads of every member of the Myreque mounted above the gates of Castle Drakan before the day is out.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Don't be so sure. There's more of us than you think.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Is there now? Do you refer to the elusive Calsidiu, the apparent leader of the Myreque?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A lie, I'm afraid. I know exactly how many of you there are. And that number isn't as big as you'd like to pretend.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A lie? Veliaf...

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: You've made your point Vanescula. How do we get to this graveyard?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A boat will be your easiest way I imagine. I'll let you worry about the details.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Incidentally, should you fail to attend...

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You'll mount our heads above the gates of Castle Drakan. Yeah, we get it.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Excellent, glad we understand one another. I will await you at the graveyard.
Vanescula leaves.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: This isn't good.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Veliaf... You lied about Calsidiu and the other Myreque?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Yes. But it was with good intention, Ivan. To believe there were more of us out there... It inspired hope in our ranks, and fear in our enemies.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: A false hope.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Better than none at all. Ivan, I have made some tough choices over my years, but every one of them was for the good of Morytania.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Okay... I understand. I don't like it, but I understand.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I don't like it either. Later, we will sit down and properly discuss this. However, at the moment I fear we have more pressing matters.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Vanescula. What do we do?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Go back to Paterdomus, Ivan. [player name] and I will handle it.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: But you heard what she said. She asked for all the Myreque. Veliaf, I'm one of the Myreque, I have to come with you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Come with us? What makes you think we're even going? What makes you think we have any intention of listening to that witch?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: We don't have a choice, Veliaf, you know that. If we don't go, she'll kill us all.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: I fear Ivan is right. It doesn't seem like Vanescula has given us any other options.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Exactly. The decision has already been made for us, so I see little point in debating it. We're going. All of us.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Dammit Ivan! I'm trying to keep you safe!

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: You can't keep me safe, Veliaf. No one can. While Lowerniel Drakan lives, none of us will ever be safe.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: We have to do this. It's the only choice we have.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: Fine. But don't expect me to even pretend to be happy about this! Breaking bread with a vampyre! What have we come to?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: We're not breaking bread with her. We're going to see what she has to offer. If she tries anything, [player name] here can deal with her, just like he did to her brother.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.player: It would be my pleasure. What's our plan?

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I will travel down to Burgh de Rott and inform Radigad and Polmafi of this plight we find ourselves in. I'll also have word sent to Safalaan and the others in Meiyerditch.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: [player name], I would appreciate it if you could escort Ivan down to Burgh de Rott.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I need to collect some things from Paterdomus first. I'll update Drezel while I'm there. Once I'm done, I'll meet you outside the temple, on the Canifis side.

an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-meeting-at-the-hau.text: I will see you both at the boathouse in Burgh de Rott. We can use the boat there to get to this graveyard. Good luck.
Ivan and Veliaf depart, leaving you alone in the woods.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-drezel-.speaker: Drezel
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-drezel-.text: Ivan told me about this business with Vanescula. You'd all better be careful out there.

options.text: Could you tell me more about the Seven Priestly Warriors?
We will, Drezel.

steps.player: We will, Drezel.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: Hey there [player name]. I think I'm all ready to depart when you are.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: We need to travel through Mort Myre Swamp to Burgh de Rott. We may encounter all kinds of evil on our way, so you'd probably best prepare to fight.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: Are you ready to go to Burgh de Rott?

options.text: I'm ready.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Then let us depart.
You escort Ivan through the swamp...

options.text: I need to prepare first.

steps.player: I need to prepare first.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Okay, I'll be here once you're ready.

options.text: How are you doing?

steps.player: How are you doing?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: I'm good. The swamps haven't beaten me yet.

options.text: How are things between you and Veliaf?

steps.player: How are things between you and Veliaf?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Oh don't be worrying about that. Veliaf and I butt heads all the time. It's harmless, though. He's like a father to me.

steps.player: He seems to worry a lot about you.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: He thinks I'd be safer back with Drezel. I can't stay hidden away forever though. Drezel's teachings were valuable, but I can ultimately do more good out here.

steps.player: And what of the Calsidiu stuff?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Hmm. I still need to think on that. Ask me again later.

options.text: What do you think of this Vanescula business?

steps.player: What do you think of this Vanescula business?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: It's dangerous, but we don't have any choice. Besides, we're no strangers to danger.

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Who knows, maybe this will even work out for us.

steps.player: And if it doesn't?

steps.speaker: Ivan Strom
steps.text: Keep that flail of yours nearby.

options.text: Let's get going.

steps.player: Let's get going.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.player: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: That was great! But we really should be heading off now.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: Rotten luck! The bridge is out. Do you think there's a way over?

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.player: I reckon we can come up with something.

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Vampyre Juvinate
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: And what do we have here? Looks like some fresh Myreque meat!

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Vampyre Juvinate
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: Hang on... That's the Slayer! The one that killed Ranis Drakan!

an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-escorting-ivan-aga.text: I'll meet you down at the boathouse. I imagine Veliaf is there already.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.text: Well, here we are. Likely going to our doom.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.text: Ever the optimist, aren't you Veliaf?

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.text: Radigad has scouted out the graveyard. It's empty, for now. Vanescula's probably waiting for all of us to arrive before she makes her move.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.player: What of Safalaan and the others?

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.text: Polmafi managed to get in contact with them. They will meet us there.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.player: I guess we'd better get going then.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.text: Indeed. No point delaying the inevitable. Hop in the boat once you're ready, friend. We're right behind you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.text: Hop in the boat once you're ready, friend. We're right behind you.

an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.speaker: Ivan Strom
an-unwelcome-surprise-talking-to-veliaf-.text: Hey. You should get into the boat if you're ready to go.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: You'd best talk to Veliaf and Safalaan. They are the big bosses after all.

options.text: Do you have another Drakan's Medallion?
I'll go speak to them.

steps.player: I'll go speak to them.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: I hope you came well armed my friend. These are dangerous times.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: True. It looks like Veliaf and Safalaan are waiting for you. We will talk more later.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: Hey [player name]. Looks like Veliaf and Safalaan want to speak to you. Let's talk after.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: Ah, [player name]. Glad to have you with us. Myreque prevail.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.player: Good to see you Vertida. How are things?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: To be honest, I don't know. Ask me again if we're still alive after this meeting.

options.text: I need another flail.
Fair enough. Talk later.

steps.player: Fair enough. Talk later.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: Hello there. Have you spoken to Veliaf and Safalaan?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
a-nice-and-simple-plan-speaking-to-the-m.text: Ah, probably best that you do. That vampyre could arrive at any moment.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Veliaf! It has been far too long my friend.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Good to see you, Safalaan. Though I wish it were under better circumstances.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Indeed. And [player name], good to see you as well. Myreque prevail.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.player: Myreque prevail, Safalaan. How are things in Meiyerditch?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: As dark as ever, my friend. The vyrewatch have doubled their efforts to find us since the death of Ranis and the citizens are being tithed more than ever before.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: That said, it does feel like there is now a glimmer of hope where previously there was only darkness. While more ferocious, the vampyres also seem a bit more cautious now.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: They know we can kill them. They finally know what fear feels like.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: We're also seeing greater support from the people than ever before. Whereas once they'd only speak of the Myreque in whispers, now they speak of us loudly and with pride.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Anyway, let's focus on the matter at hand. I must say Veliaf, over the years I've come to expect the unexpected, but your message was something else altogether.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: I mean, Vanescula Drakan herself! We find ourselves in very strange times.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Strange, and also dangerous. I do not like any aspect of this.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Well I won't pretend this isn't risky. But I have faith in [player name], here. The first human to kill a vyre, and quite the vyre it was. Vanescula would be unwise to try anything.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Speaking of [player name], about that other matter I mentioned in my message...

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Ah, of course. [player name], after due consideration by Veliaf and I, we would like to promote you to the rank of lieutenant in the Myreque. Congratulations!

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: You've done well, friend. I realise it doesn't mean much, but we wanted to thank you in some way for all of your work so far.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.player: Thank you. It's a great honour.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: I wish we had time to celebrate, but time is in short supply these days. I imagine Vanescula will be here very soon. Are we ready?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: As ready as we'll ever be. Let's do this.
Vanescula arrives at the Icyene Graveyard.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Well Vanescula, here we are. All the Myreque, just like you wanted.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Your move.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: I'm impressed Veliaf. I did fear you'd go and do something silly.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Skip the small talk. Why are we here?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Fine. Conversing with you is a chore, anyway.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: The reason I have gathered you all here is because I have an offer for you.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Now I won't deny, you've not done a bad job. Killing Ranis was no small achievement, but you managed it all the same.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Unfortunately for you, you're still no closer to the true prize.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Lowerniel Drakan.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Indeed. That is why I have come to you. Only with my help will you have any hope of killing my brother.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: And what do you gain from this?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Long ago, the land of Morytania was known as Hallowvale and it was ruled over by a race of Saradominists called the icyene.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: But then your brother came along.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Correct. Hallowvale was taken over by my kind, and Lowerniel became ruler of the newly named Morytania.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: And you know what? It was the worst thing that ever happened to us.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: My brother was a great conqueror, make no mistake. But he is a poor ruler. And now, thanks to him, our society is collapsing.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Collapsing how?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: I know you've already been investigating Damien Leucurte and his not so secret arrangement with some of Darkmeyer's nobles.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Tell me, have you worked out why this arrangement exists?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.player: We could have a good guess.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Well I can give you better than guesses. Allow me to offer some clarity.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Every day that goes by, the number of humans in Morytania decreases. Yet while this happens, our population continues to grow. Unsurprisingly, we no longer have enough blood to go around.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Yeah, yeah. We've suspected as much for a long time. Why is this relevant?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: It's relevant because while all of this happens, our great leader remains absent. Lowerniel never liked to show his face, but these days it's as if he doesn't even exist. He spends months in his chambers, refusing to see anyone.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: So you wish to take his place. What makes you think we'll help you with that?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: There was once a time where humans and vampyres lived together in a great empire. Under my rule, I would see us return to that way of life.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Morytania would become a land of peace and prosperity, with humans and vampyres living side by side.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Or we could just kill both you and your brother and take back Morytania for humanity!

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Ha! You could try. Even if you were to succeed though, which isn't likely, one of the other vampyre lords or ladies would just take over instead.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: No. If you want to save your people, my way is the only way.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Why do you need us though? Why not just kill your brother yourself?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: I could, but even today there are many in Darkmeyer who still blindly believe in Lowerniel. It will be much easier for me to take his place if I am not responsible for his demise.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: You'd have us become your scapegoats.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Is that such a bad thing? Your people would consider you heroes. You'd be the ones to finally kill Lowerniel Drakan.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: How do we know you won't just kill us once this is done?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: You don't. But Castle Drakan is impenetrable. You'll never get inside on your own, and Lowerniel clearly has no intention of coming out. This is your only option.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Oh, it's probably also worth mentioning that I can't afford any loose ends. If you decline, I would expect you to leave Morytania immediately.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: To stay would have dire consequences for your life expectancy.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Say we accept your offer. How do you propose to get us into the castle?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Ah yes, the plan itself. You will pose as my prisoners and I shall escort you to Castle Drakan. Your capture is something that even Lowerniel will be unable to ignore.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.player: And once inside, we kill him.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Exactly. A nice and simple plan.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Too simple, if you ask me.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Never happy are you Veliaf?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Of course I'm not happy. You expect us to just hop into bed with you? You are the enemy! You always have been, and you always will be! We will have no part in this.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Come now, don't be so hasty. You should at least think things over. While you do, I would appreciate a private chat with Safalaan.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Me?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Yes, you. Join me by the large mausoleum at the back of the graveyard. There is something we need to discuss.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: What makes you think we're just going to let you walk off with him?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: This is growing boringly repetitive, Veliaf. For the last time, if I wanted any of you dead, I'd have done it by now.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: It's alright Veliaf. I will go.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Hmm. Well [player name] has to go with you. I want him there in case Vanescula here tries anything.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-meeting-at-the-ic.text: Very well. Safalaan, [player name], if you'll please join me.
The meeting ends.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Safalaan Hallow. Interesting name, isn't it?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: What of it?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: The name 'Hallow'. Do you know where it comes from?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: It's common in these parts. They say it was the name of the old Saradominist rulers.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Spot on. You know your history. The family of icyene that ruled over Hallowvale were the Hallow family. And so of course, the name of the region is no coincidence.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: I'm surprised your brother didn't have it renamed 'Drakanvale'.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Good name, but not really his style I'm afraid.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: What's your game, Vanescula? Why do you care about my name?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Do you not find it odd that you share a name with the former royal family?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: No, I don't. Like I say, around here the name is pretty ordinary.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Ah, but you are far from ordinary, aren't you Safalaan? Tell me, how much do you remember of your childhood?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Nothing. I remember nothing of my childhood. You can thank your friend Vanstrom for that. He always wanted me dead, even back before the Myreque were a thing. One day he nearly succeeded.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: But your powers stopped him?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: I know many things about Safalaan. It's why we are here, in fact. But please, go on.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: It's why we're here? What do you mean? What is all this?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Finish your story. I promise that everything will be made clear.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Fine, but it's starting to seem like you already know everything anyway.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: You're right about my powers. I was able to use them to drive Vanstrom away. It came at a cost though.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: I remember nothing of the event, nor of anything that happened in my life before it. The only thing I remembered was my name.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: There, story told. Now, tell me, why are we having this conversation?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: This graveyard is no normal graveyard. It was once the private graveyard of the Hallow family. Every member of the royal family was buried here.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: When she was still in power, the ruler of Hallowvale, Queen Efaritay Hallow, had this mausoleum built. It was constructed to one day house her and her human husband, King Ascertes Hallow.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Inside, I believe you will find the truth that you've spent your whole life searching for.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Stop with these games! If you know something, tell me!

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Would you actually believe me if I did? To you, my words are just that, words. Inside this mausoleum lies something far more reliable, proof.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Well noted. We'll need to unlock it.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.player: I bet I can get it open.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Wonderful. It's an interesting lock. The icyene always were devious. From what I can tell, you'll need to ensure that the total value of each row and column matches the number at the end.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Now, off you go.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Any luck with the lock, [player name]?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Try to hurry. I don't like these games that Vanescula is playing.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: You need to get this door open. From what I can tell, you'll need to ensure that the total value of each row and column on the lock matches the number at the end.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Now, off you go.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Keep an eye on Safalaan, [player name]. I don't like leaving him alone with that vampyre.

options.text: I need another flail.
Will do.

steps.player: Will do.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Hey [player name]. You need to be over with Safalaan and Vanescula. We'll talk later.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Best we don't talk right now, [player name]. You need to be watching Safalaan and Vanescula and I don't want to distract you.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Shouldn't you be with Safalaan?

options.text: Do you have another Drakan's Medallion?
Oh yes, I'd better go to him.

steps.player: Oh yes, I'd better go to him.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Now's not the time for chat, [player name]. You're meant to be watching Safalaan and Vanescula.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: You should be keeping an eye on Safalaan and Vanescula. We will talk later.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Well?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.player: There's a plaque on the coffin.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: What does it say?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.player: 'Here lies Larina Hallow. Beloved daughter of Efaritay and Ascertes Hallow and...'

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
