a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: And?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: What does it say?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: I... I don't...

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: No! It can't be true! It can't be!

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: I'm sorry Safalaan, but it is true. You are the half- human, half-icyene son of Queen Efaritay Hallow.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: A sister... I had a sister. And my powers?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: The powers of an icyene, yes.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: But... I don't understand...

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: I realise it's a lot to take in.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: No. What I mean is, you said that this tomb was built for Efaritay and Ascertes, for my mother and father. But they're not here.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Where are they Vanescula?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Safalaan I...

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: No! No more games! I know why you've done this. You don't care for me. You're just trying to manipulate me!

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Well fine, it worked. If you want my support in killing your brother, you will have it. But you must tell me, where are my parents?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: The war for this land was long and bloody. We were winning, but with heavy losses. Lowerniel didn't mind. He was a hunter and a warrior. In his eyes, there was no death more noble than one in battle.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Many didn't share that view though, and wanted the war to be over. Ranis was one of them. He managed to infiltrate Efaritay's castle. Once inside, he captured your father, Ascertes.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: And?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Efaritay surrendered that same day. She walked into Lowerniel's camp, alone, and willingly handed herself in. I guess she had hoped that Lowerniel would free your father in exchange for her.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: But he didn't, did he?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: No. After that, I'm afraid I don't know what happened to your mother. No one ever saw her again. Only Lowerniel himself knows her fate.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: And my father?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Like I said, we suffered heavy losses in the war. We needed a way to quickly restore our numbers. Vampyrification was the answer. Your father was the first of many to go through the process.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: You turned him into a vampyre? You monsters!

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: Lowerniel turned him into a vampyre, not I.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: But you were there, by his side. Do you expect me to believe that you're not just like him?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-secret-of-saf.text: I can't control what you believe, but I am not the enemy here.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Well Vanescula, it seems you have managed to convince us. Well done.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Thank you Veliaf. Now, shall we crack on?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: What must we do?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: If you want any hope of defeating my brother, you'll need the proper weaponry.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.player: We have weaponry. We have the Ivandis Flail.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Indeed you do. Not a bad weapon by any means, but not ideal for taking on Lowerniel. He'll snap it in two before you even have a chance to use it.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: It worked well enough on Ranis.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Lowerniel is far more powerful than Ranis was. If you want to defeat him, you should take my advice.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Fine. What are you proposing?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: If I'm not mistaken, which I'm generally not, you made that weapon using research from the Haemalchemy Laboratory.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: How did you know that?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: [player name], who was it that helped you find that laboratory?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.player: Sarius Guile, your servant. Hang on... Did you send her?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Of course I did. Do you think she would have dared interact with you without my consent? Come now, surely you're smarter than that?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Anyway, I don't know much of the laboratory myself. It was Ranis that had it set up. Lowerniel wasn't very happy when he found out.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: That said, I do suspect it might have more secrets for us to discover.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.player: So you want us to go back there?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Yes. If you are able to find further research notes, I suspect we'll find a way to upgrade that weapon of yours.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.player: Okay, I'd better be off to the laboratory then.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: I would like to join you, [player name].

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Are you sure, Safalaan?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Yes. Better I be out there doing something than be stuck here brooding.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: [player name], do you remember how to reach the laboratory?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.player: It's in sector six of Meiyerditch, just south east of the daeyalt mine.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Very well. I will meet you there.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade.text: Good luck to you both.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Keep an eye on Safalaan, won't you? I worry about how he's taking things.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Good. Now you should head off to that laboratory. No point wasting time.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Yes?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: I wanted to ask you something.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Be quick then.

steps.player: Why do you hate your brother?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Why wouldn't I? He's an awful leader. My kind are slowly starving to death thanks to overpopulation, but he doesn't even seem to have noticed.

steps.player: Is killing him not a bit much?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Not really. It is the vampyre way. There was once a time when things were far more savage. We once lived in a land far more hostile than this one.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: There, new clan leaders were selected during a festival known as the Night of the Blood Moon. It was a simple concept. A full night of killing. At dawn, the one with the most kills became the new leader.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Lowerniel loved it. He won every time of course. Personally, I prefer our new way of life.

steps.player: And yet you're still happy to kill him?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: We are not the beasts we were back then, but some things do not change. Like I say, it is the vampyre way.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Now, did you want something else?

options.text: What should I be doing?
How did Ranis capture Ascertes Hallow?
Why did Lowerniel shut down the Haemalchemy Laboratory?
That's all, thanks.

steps.player: That's all, thanks.

options.text: How did Ranis capture Ascertes Hallow?

steps.player: How did Ranis capture Ascertes Hallow?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Do you know of Verzik Vitur?

steps.player: Owner of the Theatre of Blood? Who doesn't know of her?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I'd give her the credit over Ranis. The two of them shared a love for playing with their food rather than eating it. They hatched all kinds of schemes together.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: During the war, they managed to capture a justiciar, one of Efaritay's most elite warriors. They tortured him for days, until he gave them what they needed.

steps.player: Which was?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: A secret tunnel, leading directly into Efaritay's castle. The tunnel was here, in this very graveyard. Once they were inside, capturing Ascertes was easy.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: In some ways, I think Lowerniel was a bit disappointed the fighting was over. The pair were still greatly rewarded, however. Verzik ended up getting Efaritay's castle. It was quite the boon for her.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Now, did you want something else?

options.text: What should I be doing?

steps.player: Why did Lowerniel shut down the Haemalchemy Laboratory?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: I can only assume he didn't like what they were doing there.

steps.player: Well obviously. Could you be more specific though?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Are you familiar with their areas of research?

steps.player: Ways to overcome blood shortages and ways to improve your immunity to our weapons.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Essentially. The first might seem to benefit Lowerniel, but when you look deeper you can see why he wasn't a fan.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: For our kind to be less reliant on humans would be a fundamental change to our society. History has told us that leaders generally don't survive such a transition.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: As for the second, I think it's obvious why Lowerniel wanted to put a stop to that. Just ask Ranis why that research maybe wasn't overly wise.

steps.player: I see. I guess that makes sense.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Indeed. Of course, Lowerniel's long absences mean that a lot of research was already complete before the laboratory was shut down. Hence how you were able to use it against Ranis.

steps.player: Which we were only able to do because of you. Why did you send Sarius to us?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: A test. Even back then I knew that Lowerniel needed to go. I wanted to see if a partnership with the Myreque was worth exploring.

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: Now, did you want something else?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: These are dark times friend.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: They are. But maybe there's a light at the end of the tunnel.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Maybe. I guess we'll find out soon enough. Be careful out there.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Myreque prevail, [player name].

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: We'll soon be doing battle with one of the most powerful beings in existence. How are you feeling?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Surprisingly calm, to be honest. We may well die in this fight, but if we manage to defeat Drakan, it will be worth it.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: I guess it's not a bad way to go.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Exactly.

options.text: I need another flail.
See you later.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Imagine, the death of Lowerniel Drakan. Think what that could do to these dark lands.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: It's crazy to think it might actually happen.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: We've come a long way. Just one final hurdle.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: And then, peace in our time.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Let us hope, let us hope.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Hey [player name]. Looks like it's really happening. We're finally going to show Drakan what happens when you cross the Myreque.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: Looks like it. How are you feeling?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Oh I'm great. I know we can do this, especially with you on our side.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: I hope you're right to have faith in me.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Don't worry, I know you won't let us down.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Good to see you, [player name].

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Do you think we're ready for this?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: The fight with Drakan? Yes, I think so. We killed Ranis after all.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Lowerniel's a much bigger fish though.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.player: He is. But it's not just me this time. This time there's all of us. And Vanescula too, assuming she doesn't betray us.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-nice-and-simple-plan-weapons-upgrade-t.text: Let us hope.

options.text: Do you have another Drakan's Medallion?
I'd better get going.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: Good to see you, [player name]. Glad you made it here safely.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.player: And you. How are you doing?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: To be honest, I'm not sure if I've even properly taken it in yet. It's all so much. My mother, my sister... and of course, my father.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: It feels strange. I feel like I should mourn, but how do I mourn a family I can't even remember?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: And Vanstrom... My greatest enemy may well be my only remaining family. I wonder, is there anything left of Ascertes now? Is part of him still in there, buried away?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: Probably best not thinking about, I suppose. My job is to lead the Myreque. I can't let anything else distract me from that, not even my family.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: With all that's happened, I fear some of them may already be beginning to doubt me.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.player: You have their support Safalaan, I know you do.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: I hope so. I let them down with that Serafina business, and people died. I can't let them down again.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: Anyway, let us crack on. It seems that we should be able to access more of the laboratory through the doors to the south.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: They were damaged and couldn't be opened, but I think I've managed to fix them up.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.player: I didn't know you had a knack for Construction?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: Ah, one of my hidden talents. Of course, not much room for that sort of thing around here.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.player: That's a shame. I'm sure you'd make a great builder.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: Ha! It's strange to think how differently our lives could have been, is it not? Alas, here we are.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.player: I'm sorry. Maybe now isn't the best time for these kinds of conversations.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-the-meiyerditch-l.text: You have a good sense of humour my friend, even in these dark times. Do not be ashamed of that. When things are darkest, a bit of light is very welcome.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.text: Yes, but what happens if I totally lose control? Will I lose my memory like that time with Vanstrom? Or will I do something even worse?

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.player: Well now that we know the source of your powers, maybe we can find a way to help you control them.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.text: Maybe... Let us hope we can do so before it's too late.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.text: Bah, look at me, [player name]. I'm meant to be a leader, but I can barely control my own body. I'm like an old man.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.player: Well... you are the son of Queen Efaritay. I guess that makes you thousands of years old.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.text: Eugh, what an awful thought. I guess I should get myself a walking stick.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.player: I'm sure we can arrange that.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.text: Let's add it to the list. First though, the research we came here for. I'm afraid I'm still feeling a bit weak, so you'll have to do the heavy lifting on this one.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.player: Oh I see how it is! You find out you're an old-timer and now I have to do all the work!

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.text: Afraid so. My poor back simply can't take it. I've no doubt you'll manage though.

a-nice-and-simple-plan-after-defeating-t.player: Okay. I'll have a look round and see what I can find. You stay here, old-timer.

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Yes. She is our only hope of defeating her brother. In truth, I'd pretty much made my choice even before she told me about my family.

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.text: Yup. Most of the others went to the Meiyerditch hideout. But I wanted to stick around.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.text: This graveyard is one of the last remaining examples of what Hallowvale was like. I bet there's a lot to discover here.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.text: Maybe once Drakan is gone, we can get some proper archaeologists out here. I'm sure they could learn all sorts.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.player: I bet they could. You holding up okay?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.text: Oh yes. We're going to win this, I know it.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.text: Why wouldn't I be? I have faith in Saradomin. I have faith in Safalaan and Veliaf. I have faith in you. Together, we will beat Drakan.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.speaker: Ivan Strom
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-ivan.text: Have faith, friend. Anyway, I'd best let you get on.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: ...of your arrogance. What makes you so sure we won't also kill you once your brother is dead?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Oh, you could try. Although I doubt it would end well for you.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Now this is exactly what I mean.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Oh lighten up would you. No sense of humour at all.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: I am no fool. I am all too aware of my own weaknesses and how you could exploit them. When we take on Lowerniel, I don't intend to be alone.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: I have many supporters amongst the vampyres of Darkmeyer. Your small group against all of us? The fight would be brief.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Hiding behind larger numbers? Not very honourable.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Now you see, I've tried honour before. Decided it wasn't for me. Honour matters not if you're dead. I intend to keep living.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Ah, [player name], you're back. Good to see you made it okay.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Yes, yes. Wonderful to see you. Shall we get on with things?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Go ahead.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Well, the research you recovered has confirmed something I have long suspected.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Which is?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Queen Efaritay was a renowned botanist. She used this to her advantage many times during the war, breeding all kinds of plant life to use against us.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: One of these plants was the Blisterwood tree. The icyene used the sap of this tree to create poisons that were deadly to vampyres.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: However, I've always suspected the tree might have other uses. Clearly the researchers in the Haemalchemy Laboratory thought the same.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.player: So what did they find out?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: It seems that the bark of the Blisterwood tree can be used to create weapons that are deadly to my kind.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: How?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Well I'm no scientist, oddly enough. But from what I can tell, even when chopped away, the wood of the tree is very much alive. It shifts and grows in unpredictable ways, rendering our immunities useless.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: I see where we're going with this. You want us to use this tree to construct new weapons?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Well... not quite. While not perfect, the work you've already done has potential. I see no need to completely discard it.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Instead, I suggest we use wood from the Blisterwood tree to enhance the weapons you already have. When combined with the wood, I imagine that flail of yours will be quite effective.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Perfect for killing your brother. Assuming you don't kill us first.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Again with this? I've already told you, I have no need to kill you. Once Lowerniel is gone, I envisage a new age, where my kind and yours live in harmony. I need you alive for that.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: I'll believe it when I see it.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: That's fine by me.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: We're getting sidetracked here. We need some wood from this Blisterwood tree. Where do we find it?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Ah... that's the tricky bit. I know only of one Blisterwood tree. It lies in Efaritay's old Arboretum, in the middle of Darkmeyer.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: It's in the capital? We'll have no hope of getting in there.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: I don't see why we'd need to. Vanescula here can get some of this wood for us.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Really now? Do you think I have any intention of touching a tree that can kill vampyres? No. You will need to recover the wood yourself.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Darkmeyer isn't as impenetrable as you might think. I know of a way you can get in. But first, you'll need a disguise.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Now, luckily for us, my kind have some shapeshifting abilities. Many vampyres, such as myself, prefer to take on a human form. That means you should be able to fit in... with the right outfit of course.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Trader Sven sells vyrewatch disguises. We've used them in the past.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Not bad, but we'll want to make some adjustments. We need you looking less like a vyrewatch and more like a noble.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Polmafi knows how to use a needle. He should be able to sort us out.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Good idea. [player name], could you pick up a vyrewatch disguise from Trader Sven? He lives in sector one of Meiyerditch, directly south of Old Man Ral's house.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.player: Will do. I'm guessing I should take it to Polmafi after that?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: That's right. He and the others have gone back to the Meiyerditch hideout, in Old Man Ral's basement.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Once you have the disguise, we will need to scent it. We will discuss that once you have it.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.player: Okay, I'll be back when I have the disguise.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: You should get going friend. That disguise won't sort itself out.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.player: What do I need to be doing?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Go and buy a vyrewatch disguise from Trader Sven. His house is the one directly south of Old Man Ral's, in sector one of Meiyerditch.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.player: And once I have the disguise?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Deliver it to Polmafi at the Meiyerditch hideout, in Old Man Ral's basement.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Yes?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.player: I wanted to ask you something.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-talking-to-veli.text: Be quick then.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-meiyerditch-hid.player: Not too bad. We've managed to recover some more haemalchemy research. We think it can be used to further improve our weaponry.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-meiyerditch-hid.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-meiyerditch-hid.text: Well that's good to hear. Anything I can help with?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-meiyerditch-hid.player: Yes, actually. To make the improved weapons, I need to infiltrate the city of Darkmeyer. For that, I need a disguise. Veliaf said you'd be able to help.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-meiyerditch-hid.text: The city of Darkmeyer? Oh my! You'd better be careful.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-meiyerditch-hid.speaker: Polmafi Ferdygris
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-meiyerditch-hid.text: Anyhow, yes I should be able to help. What kind of disguise do you need?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: What do we need to scent it with?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Blood of course. The blood of a vyre.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.player: So I kill a vyrewatch and use their blood to scent the disguise?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Oh... no, no, no. A vyrewatch will not do. We want you to blend in with the nobles. That means we need the blood of a noble.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: There's a difference?

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Of course. The lords and ladies of Darkmeyer won't go interacting with any old rabble.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Of course. Go on then, give us some of your blood.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Oh dear Veliaf, you misunderstand. The smell of my blood will be far too recognisable to work. We need someone a bit more obscure.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Ah yes, how silly of me to not realise. You clearly have a vampyre in mind. Spit it out.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: I think we use this as an opportunity to deal with two issues in one. Damien Leucurte has become a problem that needs to be resolved. He is also a noble, albeit a lesser one.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: So we kill Damien and use his blood. Sounds good to me.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Indeed. Let's get it done. [player name], meet me outside the church in Slepe. We're going to pay Damien a little visit.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: If you want, you can use the boat to quickly get to Slepe. Should be faster than walking.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.player: Good idea. Veliaf, I'll see you there.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.text: Meet me outside the church in Slepe. We're going to pay Damien a little visit.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-kill-two-birds-.speaker: Vanescula Drakan

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.text: They don't want to mess with you my friend. I suspect you're becoming quite notorious amongst the vampyres.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Damien Leucurte
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.text: You think I'm afraid? I am a lord of Darkmeyer. I am fear!

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.player: A lord of Darkmeyer? Isn't a lord meant to have followers? Looks like yours have run away.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Damien Leucurte
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.text: Cowards! That's what they are. I was their saviour! When our great leaders abandoned us, I was the one that kept them fed!

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.text: Face it Damien, you're out of time. There's nowhere to run.

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Damien Leucurte

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Damien Leucurte

a-vyre-ry-noble-disguise-going-back-to-s.speaker: Damien Leucurte

steps.text: The death of Damien can't do any harm. That said, don't expect this to suddenly fix everything around here. The Sleeper Plague isn't the only illness in this town.

steps.player: You mean their religion?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: I do. The people here chose to follow Zamorak. A choice like that has consequences. Bad ones.

steps.player: You think they are being punished?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Not exactly. I don't believe in fate myself. I'm sure someone like Drezel would say otherwise, though. I just think that if you play with fire, you're going to end up getting burnt.

steps.player: So do you think the Sleeper Plague will go away now?

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well there shouldn't be any new cases now that Damien and Kroy are gone. That won't help those already infected though.

steps.player: Maybe there's a cure.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Maybe. I suspect this town holds a lot of secrets... but now is not the time to explore them. We have other business to attend to.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Do you have the disguise?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: I sent some of Damien's blood to Polmafi. Speak to him if you need a replacement disguise.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Well well, the vampyre slayer returns. Two of my brothers, now Damien as well. Quite the body count you're amassing.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Two of your brothers?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Did you not know? [player name] here isn't just responsible for killing Ranis. [He/She/They] also killed our younger brother, Draynor.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.player: Count Draynor, he called himself. He wasn't much of a challenge compared to Ranis and Damien, truth be told.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Ah yes, the great 'Count' Draynor. He loved his stupid titles. He was weak even before he got trapped on the wrong side of the Salve. A coward as well.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: There's a reason Lowerniel had him banished. I'm just surprised he lasted as long as he did.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Now, I assume you have a finished disguise?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Wonderful. Now we're getting somewhere. With that disguise, you should be ready to enter Darkmeyer.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: But how [does he/does she/do they] get into the city? The place is a fortress.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Almost, but not quite. I know of a small weakness in the southern wall. A crack, in sector six of Meiyerditch, just north of the daeyalt mine.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: It should be big enough for you to squeeze through, as long as you haven't recently eaten an excess of cakes.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Seems suspiciously convenient. Why hasn't the crack been filled in?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: My kind are struggling to feed themselves. They've currently got bigger worries than cracks in walls.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Besides, up until now, why would any human even consider entering Darkmeyer? Perhaps you hadn't noticed, my kind is not known for treating humans well.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Although you expect us to live in harmony once this is done. How are we meant to achieve that when each side hates the other?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: I never said it would be easy. I don't expect us to kill my brother and then have a big party. It will be work, but given time, that work will pay off.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: We'll see.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.player: So that aside, I can use this crack to enter Darkmeyer? What then?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: You'll need to get to Efaritay's Arboretum in the middle of the city. The city architects gave it facelift to help it blend in, but it's still impossible to miss.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Once inside, you'll need to chop some logs from the Blisterwood tree. We'll need enough to arm everyone, so eight logs in total.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Now, whatever happens, you must not let your true identity be exposed. If a member of the Myreque was found in Darkmeyer, the entire city would be locked down.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Well keep your disguise on for a start. You'll want a suitable name as well. Your current one isn't very fitting. If anyone asks, you're called [vampyre name].

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: [vampyre name]. It suits you, [player name].

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.player: [vampyre name], right. Anything else I should know?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: I expect you to see many things you consider undesirable while in Darkmeyer, especially where your kind are concerned.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: While you may be tempted to get involved, don't. Stay in character no matter what.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.player: Okay, I'll be back once I have the logs. Wish me luck.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Good luck [player name]. Myreque prevail.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Myreque prevail [player name].

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: You should get going friend. Darkmeyer awaits.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Good luck. Myreque prevail.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Be careful in Darkmeyer, friend. I can't even imagine how dangerous that city is.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Yes?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.player: I wanted to ask you something.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-talking-to-van.text: Be quick then.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Well, [vampyre name], you're wrong. No one can go in the Arboretum, by order of the Drakan family themselves.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Why do you want to go in, anyway?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: No, but I have a job to do.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.player: What will it take for you to let me in? There must be something you want. Do you want money?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: I have no need for your money.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Eugh, fine! There's something I need doing. Get it done for me and I'll grant you access.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: There's a juvinate who was meant to deliver something to me. He hasn't shown up. Find him and tell him that Desmodus Lasiurus is getting impatient.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.player: Sure thing! What's he meant to be delivering?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Some slaves. You heard of Gadderanks? He was some human that Vanstrom used to help collect blood tithes.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Well, he went and got himself killed by the Myreque. Vanstrom owed me a favour so he agreed to let me have his wife and child.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: You got a problem?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Good. Mordan Nikazsi is the juvinate you're looking for. He'll be somewhere in the lowest tier of the city. Now, get lost!

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Who are you?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Did you find Mordan Nikazsi?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Why are you here then? He'll be somewhere in the lowest tier of the city. Go find him!

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: Did you find Mordan Nikazsi?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: And?

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.player: He sold your slaves to Alexei Jovkai.

the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.speaker: Desmodus Lasiurus
the-branches-of-darkmeyer-infiltrating-d.text: That filthy wretch! I'll have him killed for this! Go find my slaves and bring them to me!

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: There's a path just north of the graveyard. He went for a walk in that direction.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: I'll see if I can find him.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Don't take too long.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: You need to try and find Safalaan. He went for a walk just north of the graveyard.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: Okay, I'll be back once I've found him.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Yes?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: I wanted to ask you something.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Be quick then.

options.text: What should I be doing?

steps.player: What should I be doing?

steps.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
steps.text: You're meant to be finding Safalaan. Off you go.

options.text: Why do you hate your brother?
How did Ranis capture Ascertes Hallow?
Why did Lowerniel shut down the Haemalchemy Laboratory?
Right, I'd better get going.
Why do you hate your brother?
How did Ranis capture Ascertes Hallow?
Why did Lowerniel shut down the Haemalchemy Laboratory?
Actually, never mind.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: [player name].

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: So this is it. All these years of fighting. All these years of running. It all ends today. One way or another.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: You seem troubled?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: I guess that makes two of us.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Ha! Well, I asked first.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: The human that worked with Vanstrom? Didn't you and Veliaf kill him?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: We did. Before he died though, he helped us. In return, he asked us to help his family.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: And?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: I found them, in Darkmeyer. They were in a prison, albeit a nice one. The vampyre that owned it looked after his tithes.
They're not there anymore though, thanks to me. Another vampyre has them now. One that I don't imagine will show any kindness to them.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: I assume you had no choice?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: Yes. It was the only way for me to get into the Arboretum. That doesn't change what I did, though. I broke my promise to a dying man.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: A man that worked for the vampyres.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: Because he had no other choice. Vanstrom would have killed his family otherwise.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: We make the hard choices to spare others from having to.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.player: Yes. But this time we weren't the ones who paid for it.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: When Drakan is gone, and Morytania is free, it will all be worth it.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Indeed.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: It's possible we will encounter Vanstrom today.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: And I wonder... is there anything left of the man he once was?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Does the process of vampyrification destroy everything that makes us human? Or does it just hide it?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Maybe we'll never know. And yet...

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Our whole order was built upon hope. A hope so small, it might as well have not even existed. But that never stopped us.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: I still cling on to some hope for him. Is that wrong?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Well... We could stand here forever, watching the world go by. It's just delaying the inevitable.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Time to end it.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Oh... One last thing, [player name].

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Thank you, for everything. It's been a pleasure.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Come. Let us return to the others.
You and Safalaan return to the graveyard.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Well it looks like everything is ready.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Yes. Everyone has one of the new blisterwood sickles. They are all prepared.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Good. Here's what's going to happen.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: From here, I will teleport our group to the Darkmeyer Arboretum. There, we will join with some vyres loyal to me.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: We will take your group to Castle Drakan as our prisoners. Once inside, my vyres will ensure no one enters while we deal with my brother.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: And then?

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Once Lowerniel is dead, I will teleport you all back here again. I will then announce his death to my kind and take his place as the ruler of Morytania.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: From there, we will start to build our new kingdom, together.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: We'll see.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Yes we will.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Make sure you're ready for this, [player name]. Once we start, there's no going back.

the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
the-final-preparations-calm-before-the-s.text: Good, good. Once you are ready, let me know and we will begin.

options.text: I'm ready.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: This is it. This is the day we've spent so long fighting for. Myreque prevail.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Myreque prevail.

options.text: I'm ready.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: The player and the rest of the Myreque walk into the castle grounds, guarded by Vanescula and four vyrewatch sentinels.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Vanescula? What's going on here?

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Vanstrom. I am here with a gift for my brother.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: But... that's the Myreque.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Yes. All the Myreque.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: I don't understand. How?

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Your efforts were valiant, Vanstrom. But alas, they were unsuccessful. I decided to take matters into my own hands, using a new tactic.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: I negotiated with them. Convinced them that I was on their side. After that, bringing them in was trivial.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: I... I'm sorry my lady, but this just seems too good to be true.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Well it is true. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'd best be getting inside.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: But...
Lowerniel Drakan appears in front of the castle doors.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: I rememeber when I was young. Our father would take me out into the woods, hunting.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: That was where I truly discovered what it meant to be alive.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: The constant fear. That knowledge that if you fail, your very life may well be over.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: But then at the same time, the thrill. The thrill of the chase. Of the conquest. Nothing can match it.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: One day, he decided to bring my sister along. He felt it was time for her to develop her own taste for the hunt.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: She was a natural. A raw talent I had never seen before, and rarely since. I felt a unique pride that day.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: That wasn't all, of course. There were so many things she excelled at. So many talents.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: But lying, Vanescula?
Lowerniel walks down the stairs.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Lying was never one of them.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Brother. I don't...

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Tell me, Vanescula. What is the cause of this latest betrayal? How is it I have displeased you this time?

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: I don't know what...

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Vanescula, please. This veil of lies is thinner than the humans you feast upon.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Now, the truth.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Alright.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: You have been gone too long, brother. While you spend your days hidden away, lamenting about that stupid rock, our kind suffer.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Out there, in your city, they're starving. There's not enough blood to go around and their great leader is unwilling to provide a solution.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Something has to change, or we're doomed.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Vanescula, my dear sister. You disappoint me.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: You and your kind, you have spent your years engrossing yourself in culture, in aristocracy. Pretending to be something you're not.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: And in that time, you have forgotten something.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Allow me to remind you.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: I am Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan, ruler of Morytania and the Lord of Vampyrium.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: And when you play your games of politics, you do not do so because you're smarter than me.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: When you weave your words and make your schemes, you are not getting the better of me.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: No. You do these things only because I allow it. Because your plots are so insignificant to me, that I do not even care to pay attention to them.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: But now Vanescula, now you have my attention. And now, you will be reminded what it means to cross the Lord of Vampyrium.
Lowerniel instantly kills all four of Vanescula's vyrewatch sentinels.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanescula Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: No!
Vanescula transforms into her vyre form, ready to fight her brother. However, he instantly subdues her.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Radigad Ponfit
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Let's get him!

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Kael Forshaw
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: For Andiess!

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: No! Wait!
Radigad, Kael, Vertida, and Polmafi are instantly incinerated.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Kael! Vertida!

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Vanstrom.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: My... my lord?

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Are you still loyal?

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Yes, my lord.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Lowerniel Drakan
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Good. Deal with the rest of this. My sister and I have much to discuss.
Lowerniel teleports away with an unconscious Vanescula.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: I've waited a long time for this day. The day that the Myreque finally die.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: There'll be no hellhounds or abominations this time though. This time...
Vanstrom transforms into his vyre form.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: ...I'll deal with you myself.
Vanstrom summons an energy barrier, separating Safalaan and the player from Veliaf and Ivan.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Wait!

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Safalaan don't!

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Well, well. Safalaan Hallow.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: How long I have wished to end your pitiful life...

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Stop! Just stop for a moment and think. This isn't who you really are!

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: You had a life before all of this. A life as Ascertes Hallow, my father.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Please! Think back to those days. Think back to who you used to be.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: You talk too much.
Vanstrom punches Safalaan.

a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-face-to-face-with-the-lord.text: Shall we begin?
Vanstrom attacks the player.

a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight.text: My pets will feast on your corpse!

a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight.text: Ha! Did you think you could beat me that easily?

a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight.text: See if you can survive this!

a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight-.text: I've managed to retrieve some of your things. I imagine you'll want them back.

a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight-.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
a-bloody-show-vanstrom-during-the-fight-.text: I don't have anything for you friend. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Enough! Stop this!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Stop? And why would I want to do that?

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Father, please. You must remember something? Anything!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Remember? I remember everything!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: I remember how weak Ascertes was! The pathetic love he had for his wife, for his children!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: I remember how good it felt! To be uplifted! To be made something more!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: No!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: And I remember the joy when I took your sister's skull and crushed it with my bare hands!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: No! No! No!
Safalaan's Icyene powers activate, killing Vanstrom and leaving himself unconscious. Meanwhile, two vyrewatch sentinels and a vyrewatch approach the remaining Myreque.

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Safalaan!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Veliaf...

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: [player name]! Safalaan! We need to go!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: What... What have I done?

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Ivan, teleport him out of there!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: I can't! He's too far away!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: What have I done?
A vyrewatch lands and approaches the player and Safalaan.

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: Damn you Safalaan! Damn you!

shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
shattered-after-defeating-vanstrom.text: [player name], get over here! We need to go. Now!
Ivan teleports himself, Veliaf, and the player out of Castle Drakan, leaving Safalaan behind.

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.text: He... He killed them. All of them.

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.text: What do we do? There's nothing we can do. Don't you see, Ivan? It's over. They've won.

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.text: But we can't give up. We're the Myreque!

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.text: I'm sorry, [player name]. I need some time alone.

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.player: Are you sure? I could take you back to Paterdomus.

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.text: Take this. It's not much, but it's all I can offer.

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.text: Now, please. I'd like to be alone.

shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.speaker: Ivan Strom
shattered-after-escaping-from-castle-dra.text: [player name]. I have a tome here that I think belongs to you.
